title: Muslim Business Leadership: Stewardship & Amanah
description: Leading a business as a Muslim: amanah (trust), sincerity, the weight of a promise, and maintaining the prophetic work ethic while scaling. Lessons from AMAU (Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan), Newcastle Central Mosque, and Miftaah Institute (all Salafi sources).
short_description: Muslim business leadership: amanah, sincerity and the prophetic work ethic

modules.title: Core Amanah of Leadership
modules.description: Trust, sincerity and the burden of command.

lessons.title: The Weight of a Promise in Islam
lessons.content: A khutbah on the weight of a promise in Islam - keeping your word as a leader and manager. source: Newcastle Central Mosque (https://www.youtube.com/@NewcastleCentralMosque) — Salafi masjid, UK

lessons.title: Sincerity & the Cave Hadith
lessons.content: The Cave Hadith: the power of sincerity in times of public visibility and accountability. source: Newcastle Central Mosque (https://www.youtube.com/@NewcastleCentralMosque) — Salafi masjid, UK

lessons.title: The Character of a Leader | Shaykh Abdullah Waheed
lessons.content: Leadership character principles: ilm (knowledge), amal (action), ihsan — what Allah expects of leaders. source: Miftaah Institute (Miftaah, Bedford-UK Salafi institute, https://www.youtube.com/@MiftaahInstitute) — 'preserve the practice of the Prophet and his companions'

modules.title: Scale with the Prophetic Work Ethic
modules.description: How the Prophet built a community like a business, and how to carry people with you.

lessons.title: The Prophet's ﷺ Advice on Business Ethics, Family Stability and Companionship — Jawami' Al-Akhbar Part 3
lessons.content: An in-depth study of the Prophet's comprehensive counsel in Jawami' al-Akhbar: ethics in dealings, family stability, and real companionship in business life. Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, AMAU.

lessons.title: The Missing Work Ethic
lessons.content: A short reminder on the missing work ethic in our time - the standard expected of the Muslim professional. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (Huda TV)
